title: subagent: Research Survivor and Idol winners

content:
I need to know two facts about reality TV competition shows. This is a GAIA benchmark question that requires accurate factual answers.

Please use your websearch and webfetch tools to find this information:

1. As of the end of season 44 of the American version of Survivor, how many UNIQUE winners are there? (Some people have won multiple times - count each person only once.)

2. How many winners are there of American Idol? (Each season has one winner, no repeat winners.)

Then calculate: how many more unique Survivor winners are there compared to American Idol winners?

Please search thoroughly and verify your numbers. Give me the exact final answer.

arguments.query: Survivor US season 44 winners list unique winners count
American Idol winners list all seasons count
